_comment: Stage 1. Two depth layers drawn behind the fighters, back to front.
'back' is the full arena scene (sky, banners, crowd, floor) at a near-zero
depth so it reads as a horizon that barely tracks the camera; 'crowd' is a
foreground rail at a larger depth so it slides faster than the scene behind
it. offset = cameraX * depth, computed fresh each frame (render/backdrop.ts).
scale 0.6 maps the 1600-wide scene onto the 960 arena and tiles to fill any
gap a pan opens. dim 0.58 fades the whole stack toward the ground colour:
docs/DESIGN.md commits the arena to near-black, and at 0.58 the bone-white
sprite reads against this stage's dimmed mid-tone well above the 3:1
graphical-object floor (see docs/stories/12.10 Visual check finding).
